headline: Revenue, profit, and cash surge across the board
summary_short: Revenue rose 50% year-over-year to $3.27 billion (+14% quarter-over-quarter); diluted EPS of $12.53 climbed 92% y/y as net income of $441.6 million rose 91% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue reached $3.27 billion, up 50% year-over-year and 14% quarter-over-quarter, with gross margin expanding to 25.9% from 23.5% as cost of services fell as a share of revenue. Operating income of $557 million (+86% y/y) and EBITDA of $611 million (+84% y/y) drove net income to $441.6 million (+91% y/y) and diluted EPS to $12.53 (+92% y/y). Operating cash flow was $1.14 billion versus $252.5 million a year ago, funding a cash balance of $1.85 billion (+459% y/y). Backlog rose to $14.06 billion, up from $12.45 billion last quarter and $8.12 billion a year ago. No numeric forward guidance was issued.

drivers.explanation: CEO attributed the quarter to consistent execution across all markets and record results, not a single project or segment; no one-off items disclosed.
Gross margin expanded to 25.9% from 23.5% y/y; cost of services fell from 76.5% to 74.1% of revenue, fully explaining the margin gain.
91% y/y net income growth is explained by 50% revenue growth combined with gross-margin expansion and SG&A falling to 8.8% of revenue from 9.7%.
